value.rationale: A natural finite torus-grid Rips complex previously singled out for equivariant relevance admits six geometrically distinct translation-subgroup fixed spaces in three classes and a nontrivial rational representation with two different order-five kernels. This fills a symmetry gap which ordinary Betti tables and nonequivariant wedge statements cannot address.
